title: Welcome to the Real World: How You Live in Your Own Simulation of Reality — and How We Can Still Share a World. A Theory of Persistence, Emergence, Learning, and Correctable Intelligence
description: Evolution by Emergence is an open research corpus and machine-auditable candidate architecture for resource-constrained cumulative evolution. Version v22.5 keeps the core of v22.4: CORE.md follows one model of learning, read as a network, in eight steps, and formalization/ebe-core/EbECore.lean audits 91 machine-checked results. A new core-Lean module, TamedCapture, puts the regulator inside the ledger: monitoring and repair are paid from the interest, sanctions must scale with the capturer, distributed policing survives the capture of monitors within its margin, and policing that errs needs repair. Two concept notes add duties to the quality of a relationship, stated as duties of effort, and a shared identity resting on being a learner that is autonomous and interdependent rather than on being intelligent. A new, separate section applies the theory to economics: transparent pricing, with access at cost, a separate bounty for solving problems, and a declared home for every job that profit does; its standalone core-Lean package checks 76 results with its own CI, and the section keeps its research brief, a research report and a second agent's synthesis as sources. DIALOGUE.md records how the author and an AI assistant build the model together, now in 30 entries. The release title uses ‘simulation of reality’ to mean the internal model through which a system experiences and acts in the world, not a claim that reality itself is simulated. Formal verification establishes implications under explicit premises; empirical, causal, political and normative interpretations remain open. The original repository material is dual-licensed under CC BY 4.0 OR Apache-2.0 as documented in DUAL-LICENSING.md; CC BY 4.0 is supplied here as the single Zenodo archival metadata value because the GitHub-Zenodo metadata path accepts one license value.
